/*
@Name test
@Date 5/31/2015
@Desc This is a code comment test
@Url https://voat.co/*
*/

alert("test");

Below is closer to the raw code before I hit submit. I had to add those extra '\' backslash escape characters...

\@Date 5/31/2015
\@Desc This is a code comment test
\@Url \https://voat.co/*
*/
Skip any additional markdown formatting within code blocks
